reason: I buy to resell, so I count the landed cost of every piece. 13,000 a kilo by air plus 8% on top eats my whole margin. I can find the same goods in Shorja, or bring them in by cargo with an agent for less.
objection: This is built for one person buying one pair of shoes, not for a shop. I see no bulk rate or cheaper sea option, and 2 to 3 weeks is only an estimate. I've waited weeks before and had shelves empty when I promised customers stock.
would_change_my_mind: A wholesale rate for big 1688 orders: a lower fee percentage and a cheaper per-kilo price for 20 kg and up, with a guaranteed delivery date.
